scope: Complete explicit union of the existing 150-file v5 checkpoint, 17-file English-stage-v2 increment, 21-file ordinal/model increment, 19 individually reviewed additions, and three v6 control files. The manuscript is the sole duplicated path across predecessor scopes. This is a reviewed research checkpoint, not every modified or untracked repository file.

control_files.self_binding: The manifest intentionally does not bind itself. Its SHA-256 must be taken from the independently reported final result and verified separately. It binds the other 208 files, including the allowlist and human-command document. All three controls appear in the explicit 209-path allowlist.
control_files.self_hash_placeholder: The human-command document contains a conspicuous SHA placeholder to fill from the independent final message; deriving trust from a local unverified manifest is not sufficient.

changed_predecessor_bindings.verification: Both earlier byte prefixes exactly retain their respective hashes. Both new append blocks were fully read and their numerical claims checked against public evidence. No earlier manuscript bytes or frozen predecessor records were rewritten.
changed_predecessor_bindings.consequence: Old v5 and 21-file receipt full-file checks correctly flag the later manuscript append. Preserve those historical bindings; use the explicit v6 current-byte binding for this checkpoint.

inspection.inherited_review: All inherited v5 and stage-v2 files retain their prior individual content reviews; current byte comparison found no missing file and no changed predecessor except the explicitly reviewed manuscript appends.
inspection.new_material: Every selected new source/test, public receipt, protocol, rubric, implementation record, integrated report and manuscript append was read. Authored fixtures are synthetic, not participant data.
inspection.aggregate_json: The public ordinal and technical JSON documents were fully parsed recursively; every key and text leaf was inspected. The new technical JSON has 19,237 finite numeric leaves, 87 text leaves and no raw dialogue or item-level review table. Anonymous speaker_1 through speaker_5 technical profiles are not original corpus identities.
inspection.numerical_checks: The integrated report's ten condition rows, seven factorial rows and seven leave-one-speaker-out rows match all 151 printed table numbers at displayed precision. Additional stop counts, resource chain, manuscript contrasts and source bindings match their public evidence.
inspection.binding_checks: All 58 historical ordinal source bindings and 54 new technical analysis source bindings matched current source bytes. The sole historical implementation-v1 source/test mismatch is explicitly superseded by implementation record v2 before new output analysis; v1 remains an unchanged historical record.
inspection.privacy: No raw participant quotations, authentic personal identifiers, item-to-condition mappings, private individual ratings/comments, credentials or weight payloads were admitted. Local experiment/storage paths and hash-only private provenance are not private contents.
inspection.supplemental_scan: High-confidence credential/private-key and known corpus-person-ID patterns supplemented content review. Such scans are not proof against arbitrary secrets.
inspection.prohibited_access: No protected mapping, reserved-speaker target body or private raw output was opened for this public-checkpoint review.
inspection.new_controls: The three authored v6 controls contain public file paths, hashes, aggregate provenance, exclusions and manual-only commands. They introduce no model calls, labels, source selection or Git writes.

dependency_closure.method: Existing runtime_python_dependency_paths static traversal over all selected Python entries, augmented with ordinal-lock Python source bindings and explicit local tests imported as fixtures.
dependency_closure.limitation: The 58 unchanged tracked base dependencies are inherited from the recorded repository source, not new staging additions. Static source closure does not supply private data or external runtimes.

verified_scientific_state.independent_arithmetic: PASS; analysis reproduction, not independent experimental or human validation
verified_scientific_state.scope_limits: The original retrospective single-PI ordinal findings and new technical model-pair observations remain distinct. Native stopping, tokens, latency and process RAM are not Persona Fidelity or factual/temporal correctness. Base/Instruct deployments differ in template/EOS; this is not isolated instruction-training or model-size causality.

human_review_boundary.delivery: A fixed, mixed, condition/model-masked English package contains 200 blank records and common redacted case dossiers.
human_review_boundary.privacy: All review deliveries, actual working annotations, declarations and protected mappings stay private.
human_review_boundary.missingness: The new validator accepts truthful domain NA and UNAVAILABLE and preserves genuine partial annotation. A separately frozen missingness/applicability analysis adaptation is required before any new rating-to-condition join; the old single-missing ordinal engine is not a completed new-200 analysis.
human_review_boundary.provenance: The project-involved PI has prior exposure; no independent/double-blind review or inter-rater reliability is claimed. Actual future dates, aids and judgments must not be invented.

preservation.evidence: The actual post-completion receipt was fully reviewed; the parent separately verified archive SHA-256 and the executed private backup process verified each member/source hash. This public audit did not open private ZIP members.
preservation.boundary: Local D: logical-volume preservation only; physical-device independence is unverified, not remote/off-device protection. The ZIP, private member manifest, script and any later private supplemental copies are excluded. This v6 control creation happened after the ZIP and is not falsely claimed to be inside it.

unavailable_or_separately_acquired: Permitted private speaker/source materials, exact prompts/references, raw journals, tokenization receipts and sealed private manifests/snapshots.
Original human submissions, provenance declarations, historical and new protected maps, private linked analysis rows and review dossiers.
Pinned model weights and metadata caches, llama.cpp native CPU executable/DLLs, virtual environments and frozen Jinja2/MarkupSafe template runtime.
public_reproducibility.environment: Historical environment used Python 3.14.3/pytest 9.1.1. Existing hashlib.file_digest use requires Python>=3.11 despite broader project metadata; Python3.10 clean-clone execution is not established.
public_reproducibility.generation: Generation repeatability is distinct from arithmetic reproduction; bit-identical generation across environments is not promised. Completed model batches must never be rerun merely to checkpoint.
public_reproducibility.archival_head: Recorded source HEAD remains provenance; the new archival adapter does not require current HEAD equality after a legitimate human commit, while exact executable/input/source bytes remain checked.
public_reproducibility.recorded_implementation_deviation: Analysis adapter implementation occurred after execution registration, before new response analysis. Its current-HEAD archival correction is preserved in implementation records v1/v2; it is not falsely labelled a pre-generation implementation freeze.

verification_and_git.required_before_staging: Verify manifest SHA from the independent final message, all other208 file hashes/lengths, exact209-path allowlist and empty index. Then use only the209 literal per-path staging commands. Unexpected existing staged work requires manual review, not automatic reset.
verification_and_git.optional_checks: Owner-authorized archive verify; NA/UNAVAILABLE-capable draft validation only when a genuine WORKING.csv exists, saving separate private feedback; authored pytest fixtures. No register, run, write-analysis, prepare-review or generation command is provided.
verification_and_git.test_evidence: Relevant authored-fixture tests were run and documented in the earlier implementation/research records. The checkpoint reviewer did not rerun expensive work or recast parent results as an independent scientific result.
